title: Vector Quantized Diffusion Model for Text-to-Image Synthesis
layout_note: Two full-width stage panels stacked top to bottom (Step1 above Step2), each read left to right. In Step2 the Markov chain x_T -> x_0 runs along the top; the denoiser container sits below it, x_t drops down into it and its output climbs back up to x_{t-1}, while the text branch (prompt box -> BPE -> y -> Text Encoder) enters from the lower left.
grouping: Each stage is a full-width rounded panel with a thin light-grey border on white, titled in its top-left corner ('Step1: VQ-VAE', 'Step2: VQ-Diffusion'). In Step1 the Codebook is its own rounded container (lavender outline, faint lavender fill) floating above the encoder-decoder line and tied to Q(.) by one curved line. In Step2 the network is one large rounded container ('Diffusion Image Decoder', dark-blue outline, pale blue-grey fill) holding repeated rounded sub-containers, each pairing an AdaLN box with a Transformer Block box, separated by three blue dots. Colour families group meaning: green for every discrete-token object (codebook vectors, quantized index grid, token strips, state circles), grey-blue for encoder/decoder, a single warm peach shape for the text encoder; Step1 arrows are lavender, Step2 arrows grey.
shapes_depth: Flat 2-D throughout, no shadows or 3-D blocks. Encoder and Decoder are grey trapezoids (narrowing / widening) with rotated labels; the Text Encoder is a peach trapezoid. Containers have medium corner radius; Q(.) and BPE are small rounded pills. Diffusion states are pale-green circles with a thin blue-grey outline holding italic math labels. Discrete latents are drawn as small cell grids: a 4x4 green index grid after quantization and 1-D green strips of indices with grey 'M' (masked) cells above each state. Codebook entries are tall narrow green bars labelled z_1 ... z_K. AdaLN and Transformer Block are tall rectangles with vertical text, AdaLN lighter than the grey-blue Transformer Block. The text prompt sits in a square-cornered grey-bordered box. Thin arrows: curved in Step1 from/into the photos, orthogonal elbow routing in Step2, one dashed arc for the forward process.
proposed_highlight: The method's two stages are named only in the panel titles (plain, not bold, no legend). The paper's denoiser, 'Diffusion Image Decoder', gets the only tinted, dark-blue-outlined container in the figure and is opened up in place to show its AdaLN + Transformer Block pairs; the text encoder stands out as the only warm-coloured shape.
lesson: One green token motif carries the discrete latent through the whole figure - a 2-D index grid after quantization, then 1-D index strips with grey 'M' mask cells above each Markov-chain state - so the reader sees corruption go from all-masked x_T to fully filled x_0 without reading a formula.
notes: Forward process is a dashed arc from x_{t-1} back to x_t labelled q(x_t|x_{t-1}); the reverse step is the solid arrow below it labelled p_theta(x_{t-1}|x_t, y). Timestep t enters each AdaLN from above, text features enter each Transformer Block from below. Real photos (input and reconstruction) bracket Step1 at left and right. Venue/year verified by the scout (CVPR 2022 on openaccess.thecvf.com; venue_source semantic-scholar).

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

insights.structure: Two stacked rounded panels titled 'Step1: VQ-VAE' (photo -> trapezoid Encoder -> Q(.) with a lilac Codebook z1..zK above -> green token grid -> Decoder -> photo) and 'Step2: VQ-Diffusion' (a chain of green token-state circles x_T ... x_t, x_{t-1} ... x_0 above a blue 'Diffusion Image Decoder' box of AdaLN + Transformer Block pairs).
insights.data: Discrete latents are green number grids and number strips with 'M' for masked tokens, shown above each diffusion state; the text prompt is a quoted sentence going through BPE and a peach trapezoid Text Encoder.
insights.emphasis: The token strips over x_T to x_0 show masks being replaced by indices step by step, and the forward q and reverse p_theta transitions are labelled with their equations on dashed and solid arcs.
insights.flow: Step 1 runs left to right; in Step 2 the state chain runs left to right on top, while the decoder below takes x_t, t and the text embedding and loops its output back up to x_{t-1}.
insights.avoid: Many thin grey feedback lines inside the decoder box (t and text embeddings to every block) crowd the lower panel.

arrangement.units: two rounded grey-bordered panels stacked vertically, each titled with its step; the decoder is a nested blue panel with inner rounded block pairs
arrangement.inputs_as: a photo (step 1) and a quoted caption (step 2)
arrangement.shared: the codebook token indices link the two steps
